<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="HGgxUCvzynjRqGD6d1mJ"> <mxGraphModel dx="3283" dy="1767" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
autonumber
actor StockManager
participant \"InventoryUI : ReactView\" as UI
participant \"InventoryController : ExpressAPI\" as Ctrl
database \"PostgreSQL : Database\" as DB

StockManager -> UI: inputNewQuantity(productID, qty)
UI -> Ctrl: PUT /api/inventory/update
Ctrl -> Ctrl: validateInput(qty)
Ctrl -> DB: UPDATE products SET stock = qty
DB --> Ctrl: confirm Update
Ctrl -> Ctrl: checkLowStockThreshold()
Ctrl --> UI: 200 OK (Updated)
UI --> StockManager: display \"Stock Updated Successfully\"
@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="bLvvhFlCX3psBY_E-q13-4"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="1119.55" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
